phi.name: ASQ-PHI
phi.provenance: External. Weatherhead, Golovko & McCaffrey (2026), Data in Brief 65, 112586, MIT, commit fdb371c. LLM-generated clinical search queries with no patient record, so ScrubX runs without its record lookup. It counts hospitals as geographic locations, which ScrubX does not try to mask, and labels no ages, which ScrubX masks anyway. Titles and field words are stripped from its gold values.
